shellCommands.command: cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -40; grep -n "configure\|useLang\|Lang\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/ | head -30

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/App.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("const { t } = useI18n();","const { t, language } = useI18n();")
s=s.replace("t(`language.${useI18n().language}`)","t(`language.${language}`)")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/main.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { App } from './App';","import { App } from './App';\nimport { I18nProvider } from './i18n/I18nProvider';")
s=s.replace("      <App />","      <I18nProvider>\n        <App />\n      </I18nProvider>")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -12; git status --short
